schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Communication (id INT IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, comm_action NVARCHAR(255), comm_channelid INT, payload NVARCHAR(MAX))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comm_action ON Communication(comm_action)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comm_channelid ON Communication(comm_channelid)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payload ON Communication(payload)
generation_sql: INSERT INTO Communication (comm_action, comm_channelid, payload) SELECT CASE WHEN n % 10 = 0 THEN 'Deskwork' ELSE 'Other' END, n % 100, CONCAT('Payload_', n) FROM (SELECT TOP {row_count} ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM sys.objects) AS numbers

tables.name: Communication
tables.purpose: Primary table for reproducing insert blocking and contention.
tables.distribution_notes: Simulates a large OLTP table with skewed data distribution in comm_action.

calibration_queries.sql: SELECT comm_action, COUNT(*) FROM Communication GROUP BY comm_action
calibration_queries.objective: Verify skewed distribution of comm_action values.
